coordinateSystem: Planetocentric latitude; east-positive longitude; Mars, not Earth.
traverseNotes: Vertices selected from original NASA geometry using per-segment Douglas-Peucker simplification at approximately 2m tolerance; source segment endpoints retained. These are historical driven paths, not safe astronaut routes.
